KEYSTONE MT5 — Setup (Step 1: read only)

Build MT5 BUILD 2026-10-24a • for MetaTrader 5 (IC Markets) on Windows

What this version does

Shows your account (balance, equity, open P/L, margin), the Market Watch prices and every open ticket and pending order, live, in the Keystone window. It contains no trading code: it cannot open, change or close anything. Safe on your real account.

1The two files

  • KeystoneBridge.mq5 — the small bridge for MetaTrader 5
  • KeystoneMT5.exe — the Keystone app
Save both, for example on the Desktop.

2Put the bridge into MT5

  • MT5 → File → Open Data Folder → open MQL5 → Experts.
  • Copy KeystoneBridge.mq5 into that Experts folder.
  • In MT5 open the Navigator (Ctrl+N) → right-click Expert Advisors → Refresh.

3Compile it once

  • Double-click KeystoneBridge in the Navigator → MetaEditor opens.
  • Press F7 (Compile). The bottom must say 0 errors. If not, send a screenshot.

4Allow the local link

  • MT5 → Tools → Options → Expert Advisors.
  • Tick Allow WebRequest for listed URL and add 127.0.0.1 → OK.
  • Make sure the Algo Trading button in the MT5 toolbar is ON (green).
The link stays inside your PC; nothing goes to the internet.

5Start the app

  • Double-click KeystoneMT5.exe.
  • First time only: if Windows asks for the .NET 8 Desktop Runtime, click Yes (free, from Microsoft), install it, then open the app again.
  • If Windows SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC": click More info → Run anyway (the app is new and not signed yet).
  • The app opens on ⚙ SETUP: "waiting for the KeystoneBridge EA".

6Start the bridge

  • Drag KeystoneBridge from the Navigator onto any ONE chart (e.g. XAUUSD) → OK.
  • The chart's top-left says Keystone: connected to the app.
  • The app turns green (● LIVE • REAL) and opens 💼 POSITIONS.

7Check

  • Header: account number, REAL, HEDGING, 1:500, balance, equity, open P/L, margin level, the equity bar.
  • 💼 POSITIONS: your tickets per symbol (lots bought / sold, net, P/L) and the pending orders.
  • 👁 MARKET: every Market Watch symbol with bid / ask and spread.
  • Send a screenshot — then the next step (the chart) follows.

If something is not right

  • Chart says "add 127.0.0.1 …" → step 4 is missing.
  • Chart says "waiting for the Keystone app" → the app is not open (step 5).
  • App says "port 47123 is busy" → Keystone MT5 is already open; close the second window.
  • App red "MT5 DISCONNECTED" → MT5 was closed or the EA removed from the chart; put it back (step 6).
